about: Curated layer of the scene graph. Only names, ordering, notes and launch recipes live here. Event membership, flags, maps, text (original and authored), callers and code lines are derived by engine/scene-graph.js from the ROM and the engine source. Event ids are hex strings; maps are decimal. Notes paraphrase; they never quote cartridge text.

scenes.title: Prologue: the BOY's opening
scenes.notes: The retail opening runs untouched as BOY until the sword clearing, where Goku's pod takes over.

scenes.title: Title and Mana legend
scenes.notes: Original legend narration over the intro log. The title layer replaces the logo with Secret of GOKU and the credit line.
scenes.dialogue: Original narration, unchanged (prologue events are exempt from the story compiler).

launch.note: Plays on every fresh load before the title: open the player without ?start or ?scene. ?start=title lands just after it.

scenes.title: Log crossing and waterfall fall
scenes.notes: The village boys dare BOY across the log; he falls into the river. Event 106 is also borrowed by the late-game test boot.
scenes.dialogue: Original BOY dialogue.

launch.note: Plays from New Game; press Start/X through the name entry.

scenes.title: Mana Sword and Saiyan pod crash
scenes.notes: BOY reaches for the sword; the pod crashes on him. Goku climbs out, pulls the sword (which crumbles into dust) and the ghost spawns. The arrival hand-off is a single native event splice; text, ghost, inventory and flags still run in the interpreter.
scenes.dialogue: Same-length player-line patches in the sword scene (dialogue-patches.js) plus Goku's parking joke from the arrival event data.

launch.note: The arrival plays while ?start=sword is built; to watch it, open ?start=title and start a New Game. The launch lands just after it.

scenes.title: First Rabite
scenes.notes: Walk-on reaction to the first enemy on the path back to Potos.
scenes.dialogue: Player line retargeted to Goku by the story compiler.

scenes.title: Potos: the man from the crater
scenes.notes: Villagers blame Goku for Randi's death and the Sword. Luka's Dragon Ball plan is introduced.

scenes.title: Monsters at Potos and the Elder's summons
scenes.notes: Elder, Elliott and Timothy confront Goku about Randi and the bag of sword dust while monsters surround the village.
scenes.dialogue: Rewritten through storyDialogue (the crater/Randi blame thread); Goku apologises casually.

scenes.title: Elliott falls; Mantis Ant
scenes.notes: The ground opens under Elliott; Goku follows him down by choice, then the Mantis Ant fight and the knight's rescue. Potos-specific command rewrites keep the hole pieces, door 08D, battle and reward flags.
scenes.dialogue: Mantis aftermath lines patched (the knight sizes Goku up instead of the boy; Goku asks if the dust can be glued).

scenes.title: The Elder's house
scenes.notes: Villagers petition the Elder; the Elder's private talk about Randi's mother belongs to Randi and is not given to Goku.
scenes.dialogue: Adapted: Goku does not inherit Randi's childhood; the Elder tallies Elliott saved versus Randi killed.

scenes.title: Banished from Potos
scenes.notes: The gatekeeper banishes Goku. Flying back over the village replays the guard's kick with an authored joke (9B) that clarifies the ban includes the air.

scenes.title: Water Palace, Luka and the Dragon Balls
scenes.notes: Luka reframes the quest: seven Dragon Balls inside the palace Mana Seeds, wished on to restore Randi and the Sword.

scenes.title: Dyluck's troops leave the crossroads
scenes.notes: Dyluck's soldiers march off toward the witch. Goku only learns who Dyluck is from the people involved.
scenes.dialogue: Mostly original; the whip shortcut sign notes Goku can just fly.

scenes.title: First audience with Luka
scenes.notes: Jema escorts Goku to Luka. The fear choice (133) is replaced with a single option leading to an authored reply (9C), then the retail sword/Fortress exposition and the seed sealing.
scenes.dialogue: Luka explains the Sword had kept the Fortress asleep and the crash broke its seal; Goku proposes blowing it up and is told to collect the Balls first. Authored in storyDialogue and story-events (133, 9C).

scenes.title: Luka's advice and save menu
scenes.notes: Mod replacement of Luka's repeat talk: Advice (85, generated per Ball count, or a Dryad invitation once seven are held) and Save (86 → native save menu 90). The one-time Spear gift (13A) still runs first via 92. 87/88 are retired travel choices that now loop back. 8A (a post-wish 'enjoy quiet travelling' reply) is still authored but no choice or route dispatches it any more.
scenes.dialogue: All authored. Advice text is generated at load time per collected-ball count in native-story.js.

scenes.title: Goblin pot capture and escape
scenes.notes: Goku plays along with the goblins' cooking threats rather than breaking the pot; the girl (Primm, not yet recruited) rescues him. Native capture/escape choreography retained.
scenes.dialogue: Goku's lines rewritten as cheerful play-acting.

scenes.title: Geshtar raids the Water Palace; Jabberwocky
scenes.notes: Geshtar binds the party and breaks the seed's seal; the Jabberwocky fight follows, then Luka is found locked in the basement.
scenes.dialogue: Geshtar/Luka binding exchange adapted in sceneDialogue (Goku offers to break the spell; Luka begs him not to beside the seed).

scenes.title: Water Seed resealed; Luka sends Goku on
scenes.notes: After the seed is recovered from Kilroy's ship, Luka reseals it (first Dragon Ball case) and points to Joch and the palaces.
scenes.dialogue: Seed-case/Dragon Ball explanation authored; Jema's Pandora report retained.

scenes.title: Pandora, the witch and Gaia's Navel
Pandora's listless people
scenes.notes: Phanna vanishes, the castle is in a daze, Jema points to the southern ruins.
scenes.dialogue: Mostly original; companion references filtered when absent.

scenes.title: The girl, her father and Dyluck
scenes.notes: The girl recognises Goku from the pot and recruits him to rescue Dyluck; she argues with Elman and storms out.
scenes.dialogue: sceneDialogue swaps the 'swordsman' framing for the bag of dust and has Goku agree to help.

scenes.title: Gaia's Navel: Primm turns back
scenes.notes: Retail Primm refuses Gaia's Navel and splits off. The mod short-circuits the refusal (1BD jumps straight to 6F4) so the route stays open.
scenes.dialogue: Refusal skipped; suggestions filtered when Primm is absent.

scenes.title: Dwarf Village, Rabiteman and Watts
scenes.notes: The village shakes, the Rabiteman show swindle, the sprite child's backstage confession, Watts reforges the sword dust. 368 (Dwarf pit) no longer needs a Magic Rope for a flying Saiyan.
scenes.dialogue: Watts reacts to a bag of dust instead of a sword (storyDialogue).

scenes.title: Tropicallo and Popoi joins
scenes.notes: Earth Palace approach boss. Goku's authored boss reaction plays first; then the sprite is named and joins, and the Elder explains Elinee's lava seal.
scenes.dialogue: bossReactions[1B9] prepended; sprite name/brother lines adapted.

scenes.title: Haunted Forest and the girl joins
scenes.notes: The girl screams, fights the werewolf, insists on 'we'. 40 is the native naming/recruit event; the haunted-forest barriers are ki-breakable.
scenes.dialogue: Recruitment banter adapted; she asks what to call him.

scenes.title: Elinee's castle and Spikey Tiger
scenes.notes: Gate opened by force (authored 8C), jailed soldiers, Elinee sends the party to Thanatos; Spikey fight with an authored reaction.
scenes.dialogue: Elinee gets new insults for the noisy man; Goku asks for more big cats.

scenes.title: Elinee yields; Whip; Luka's telepathy
scenes.notes: Elinee confesses the herb trade with Thanatos; Luka calls the party back to the Water Palace.
scenes.dialogue: Elinee's surrender rewritten (Goku was only warming up).

scenes.title: Pandora Ruins: Thanatos
scenes.notes: Phanna on a one-way trip; first Thanatos meeting. The ruins exit is a breakable door.
scenes.dialogue: Thanatos remarks on the absurd ki and the broken Sword.

scenes.title: Wall Face
scenes.notes: Thanatos leaves the villagers; Wall Face fight.

scenes.title: Jema in the ruins; Pandora's treasure
scenes.notes: Jema explains Thanatos's life-energy theft; the King's treasure room opens.

scenes.title: Undine's cave and Biting Lizard
scenes.notes: 231's Elinee gate check is stripped so Undine can be rescued early. Undine grants water magic to companions actually present.

scenes.title: Earth Palace, Gnome and the Earth Dragon Ball
scenes.notes: Gnome's guards, Fire Gigas (237 authored reaction), Gnome freed, and the Earth seed grants the first palace Ball. Without Popoi the seed event is truncated after its grant and advances the same flag.
scenes.dialogue: Gnome's 'wife' joke answered with Chi-Chi; the Earth Ball line is authored.

scenes.title: Kilroy's ship and the Water Seed
scenes.notes: The Boss and boys overload the stolen seed; Kilroy fight; seed recovered.

scenes.title: Cannon landing in Upper Land
scenes.notes: Popoi bumps his head again on landing; seasons forest begins.
scenes.dialogue: Absent-companion lines removed.

scenes.title: Moogles and Pebblers
scenes.notes: Pebblers have taken the Moogle village; Watts climbs out of his hole.

scenes.title: Sprite village in shambles; Spring Beak
scenes.notes: Popoi's village is wrecked; Spring Beak; Popoi's memory scene (party-specific).

scenes.title: Grandpa and Sylphid
scenes.notes: Popoi's grandfather in the Wind Palace; Sylphid's power and the Wind Ball. Sylphid's grant also gives Goku the scouter (see the scouter scene).
scenes.dialogue: Solo/partial-party alternatives replace the grandfather conversation when Popoi is absent.

scenes.title: Matango and Truffle's legends
scenes.notes: The noblemen hail the knight; Truffle's white-dragon legend.

scenes.title: Great Viper
scenes.notes: Authored reaction to the snake; cave rock-fall orb.

scenes.title: Rescuing baby Flammie
scenes.notes: Goku rescues the young dragon while noting he can already fly. Flight text spans are patched in place (flightDialogue); the native rescue still progresses.
scenes.dialogue: flightDialogue: Goku offers to carry Flammie; the drum becomes a toy; the ring item is renamed Fly.

scenes.title: Desert and the Sandship
scenes.notes: Goku plays along for a free lunch. Only companions actually aboard are marked captive (28B filters SET_FLAG for absent members). Sergo's first talk runs straight into his escape plan (72).
scenes.dialogue: sandshipDialogue: Goku could fly out at any time; he is playing along.

scenes.title: Kamehameha breakout from the engine room
scenes.notes: Goku sees the chained engine-room slaves. Sergo pushes his sneaking plan (73, the original route); Goku can instead choose KAMEHAMEHA (75) and fire it himself (hold L+Y). Any full-power wave fired below deck while captive breaks out (planned 78, otherwise 79): the screen whites out and the escape door (74) reloads Goku's room as a wreck, a hull breach where the beam left the room, fires, smoke and a red alarm. 76 frees the slaves but returns nobody. Guards are gone and Kakkara desert monsters roam every room; entering the kitchen starts 295 for a captured Popoi and entering the cabin 29C for a captured Primm. The crisis cue replaces the ship's song, punches and waves break bulkheads, and flight crosses every wall; a door flown onto from any side fires through 7A. The wreck absorbs every unfinished route: flying off the ship with captives aboard ditches them (King Kai objects, Goku shrugs), and any later visit to desert map 67 finds the crashed ship (7E) and can board it (7F) or leave it for later (80); ditched companions are mad at Goku when rescued. Five broken bulkheads shake the ship apart (7D): every captive rejoins and the arc's own ending (2A1, inlined from the cartridge) lands the party on map 91 with the freed crew at stage 12. With everyone back, the deck (77) starts Geshtar (29E) and the Mech Rider.

scenes.title: Morie's cabin shortcut
scenes.notes: 29C is routed per checkpoint: retail when $CF28≥7, otherwise A1 (guards skipped, Goku fights the Empire boarding party) or A2 (a real captive Primm keeps her rescue).

scenes.title: Geshtar's game: Mech Rider 1
scenes.notes: Authored machine reaction after the fight.

scenes.title: Kakkara and the Sea Hare's tail
scenes.notes: Amar trades water for the tail.

scenes.title: Fire Palace, Minotaur and the stolen seed
scenes.notes: Orb rooms (ki counts as every element), Minotaur, the seed stage. The skipped orb room is prepared on entry by story-areas.

scenes.title: Paradise Town stove and Salamando
scenes.notes: The Boss uses Salamando as a heater.

scenes.title: Ice Castle puzzles and Triple Tonpole
Santa and Frost Gigas
scenes.notes: Choice-gated confrontation, Frost Gigas, Santa restored.

scenes.title: Northtown, Southtown, Gold City and the Empire
The Boss doubts the knight; Kettle Kin
scenes.notes: The Boss and boys mock the 'Legendary Knight' then flee.

scenes.title: Southtown resistance and the password
scenes.notes: Mara's key; door password sequence.

scenes.title: Northtown and Krissie
scenes.notes: Resistance welcome; the castle door is knocked in (authored 8D).

scenes.title: Northtown castle: jail, Metal Mantis, Mech Rider 2, Flammie escape
scenes.notes: Emperor traps the party; the jail arena keeps its live Metal Mantis; Mech Rider 2 with authored reaction; Truffle and grown Flammie rescue them.

scenes.title: Gold City, Lumina Tower and Lumina
scenes.notes: The locked tower door offers key or Kamehameha (authored 59D). Blue Spike, Gorgon Bull, Lumina's Light Ball.

scenes.title: Northtown Ruins: Dyluck's possession
scenes.notes: Goku interrupts the abduction: Dyluck briefly resists Thanatos and sends Goku through the door. No absent victim is staged or recruited (the NTR seal is ki-breakable and staged by 9D).
scenes.dialogue: Authored 555/557 in four party variants.

scenes.title: Thanatos, Vampire and the freed people
scenes.notes: Authored 558 removes departed actors at stage 6 before stage 7 spawns the boss. Old checkpoints with a captive Primm get the retail rescue.

scenes.title: Tasnica, the Moon Palace and Joch
Tasnica's spy and Dark Stalker
scenes.notes: Jema warns of a spy; the party is jailed, then unmask the impostor king.

scenes.title: Time Chamber sparring: Goku versus Vegeta
scenes.notes: Jehk opens the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, interrupting Vegeta's training. Goku spars alone against base Vegeta and then Super Saiyan Vegeta. They agree to a draw and return safely; a stopped match allows a retry. The exact original party rejoins, and Joch's reveal and progression remain native.

scenes.title: Mandala's broadcast room
scenes.notes: A room of radios playing news, songs and quiz shows; one set is broken and one explodes. The last broadcast reports the Mana Beast approaching.
scenes.dialogue: Original lore text, unchanged.

scenes.title: Grand Palace and the Sunken Continent
Fanha, Hydra and Hexas
scenes.notes: Fanha asks who killed the Emperor; Hexas keeps her native fight. Frieza, watching, finishes Fanha with an offscreen shot (4A2).

scenes.title: Geshtar's machine: Mech Rider 3
scenes.notes: Retail Mech Rider III is back: Thanatos turns Geshtar into the machine (4A3, room 419; requested on entry because flight can skip its floor marker) and the fight runs on the Mana Fortress (237). 4A4's Fortress launch then hands over to Frieza's Death Ball on the deck.

scenes.title: Death Ball from the Mana Fortress deck
scenes.notes: After Mech Rider III the Fortress lurches (retail 4A4's opening); Frieza lands on the deck, fires the Death Ball into the core and starts the five-minute crisis. Dryad sends the eighth Ball telepathically; the native 4A4 exit and Mode 7 flight follow.

launch.note: Defeat Mech Rider III; the deck Death Ball follows on 237.

scenes.title: The Emperor breaks the seals
scenes.notes: Seal-breaking stage; Phanna's apology; Sheex; palace orbs.
scenes.dialogue: Emperor's 'final seal' line authored to reference the already-awake Fortress.

scenes.title: Dryad, the melting seal and the rising continent
scenes.notes: The Dryad seed; the seal melts and the continent surfaces. This transition is where Frieza interrupts in the mod.

scenes.title: Frieza and the five-minute crisis
scenes.notes: Mainline villain added by the mod. Event slots 0xA7–0xDD, 0xF6, 0x129–0x12A are END-only retail slots repurposed for authored scripts.

scenes.title: Frieza kills the Emperor and steals the Dragon Balls
scenes.notes: An offscreen finger laser kills the Emperor at the altar (431). Frieza reveals himself, steals the Balls, names the eighth at the Mana Tree, and leaves to watch the generals (7B sets the 'palace' stage). No crisis yet: Hexas and Mech Rider III still stand between Goku and the Fortress.
scenes.dialogue: Fully authored in buildFriezaEvents; companion lines only for recruited members.

scenes.title: Continent sinks; twilight world
scenes.notes: D8 reuses retail 4A4's exit, party launch and Mode 7 handoff. The twilight world state is applied (activateTwilight). Jema's sunken-continent talk gets the crisis override.

scenes.title: Five-minute crisis around the world
scenes.notes: Not a timer. Every native NPC interaction gets one prepended crisis greeting window (luka/jema/watts/shop/inn/elder/dryad/people0-3) chosen by crisisGreeting(); King Kai radios when Goku first flies into the changed sky.
scenes.dialogue: crisisGreetings and crisisFlightMessages in frieza-crisis.js.

scenes.title: Luka's Dryad invitation and Kai's reminder
scenes.notes: Before the Tree confrontation, Luka and Kai direct Goku through Pure Land. After the Tree falls, guidance points to Frieza in the Fortress.

scenes.title: Mana Fortress deck
scenes.notes: 62B's flag gate is stripped so Goku can enter early (which also triggers Frieza's entrance if unseen). Fortress shield, aerial approach and collateral destruction live in world-ki and fortress-collapse.

scenes.title: Super Saiyan flight at the Fortress
scenes.notes: World-flight aerial shot facing the moving Fortress; beams deflect off its shield.
scenes.dialogue: fortressDeflectionMessages.

scenes.title: Frieza's entertainment: empowered Thanatos
scenes.notes: 4E1 is routed: pending entrance → offer; unresolved Frieza → trial (F6) or showdown (C1). F6 has Frieza feed Thanatos ki; the native Dark Lich loader/defeat remain. 12A (after-trial) replaces 42D's Mana Beast tremor while the trial is active. Without Frieza, authored 4E1/42D replace the retail scene so solo parties work.

scenes.title: Popoi's death and permanent Super Saiyan
scenes.notes: Popoi challenges Frieza (recruited, or as a guest who is temporarily added), Frieza kills him, Goku transforms permanently.

scenes.title: Frieza ground fight (three stages)
scenes.notes: Playable fight owned by JS: Death Ball/disc/laser one at a time, 100% muscular form, deck tiles torn out. Defeat pauses on DEFEATED and retries the phase.

scenes.title: Collateral montage and pullback into space
scenes.notes: Starts at the end of ground phase two: collateral shots (establish, warn, impact, aftermath), then a continuous pullback following the beam off the planet.
scenes.dialogue: orbitIntroLines and collateral captions in frieza-cinematic.js.

scenes.title: Orbital fight and beam struggle
scenes.notes: Tiny fighters over a rotating globe with camera zoom; the moon, another planet and a fleet can be destroyed by stray attacks; ends in a Kamehameha beam struggle (charge, release, mash B).
scenes.dialogue: orbitIntroLines in frieza-cinematic.js.

scenes.title: Frieza defeated; Luka's questions
scenes.notes: The orbital counter already destroys Frieza; C7 only plays the defeat cue (C8), Dryad and Luka's healing and the pouch return, then jumps straight into the Mana Beast entrance (429).

scenes.title: Pure Land and the Mana Tree
The Tree's barrier
scenes.notes: Authored 4D8: the Tree tells Goku Randi is safe with it.

scenes.title: Pure Land gates and dragons
scenes.notes: Blasting a gate (9E–A0) skips only that gate's guardians and never lowers progress.

launch.note: Lands at the first gate (5D8, the scene's first root, is its save point). Fire a full wave at the gate to breach it.

scenes.title: Frieza destroys the Mana Tree
scenes.notes: Chase Frieza through Pure Land. He demands the eighth Ball, Goku reveals Dryad gave it to him, and Frieza destroys the Tree with a Death Ball before retreating to the Fortress. Native Tree reveal, collapse, spirit scene and rewards remain. The saved pursuit step prevents skipping directly to the final duel.

launch.note: The chase opens with the retail save prompt (5DA); answer No to continue.

scenes.title: Mana Fortress and the Mana Beast
Fortress interior: Buffy and Dread Slime
scenes.notes: Authored jelly reaction after Dread Slime.

scenes.title: Mana Beast entrance and the seven-seed feed
scenes.notes: 429 (intact Fortress) or 8F (destroyed) open the fight. 93/94 check the Balls; 9A goes to 96 when all seven seeds can be fed (Goku powers up the Beast over Kai's protests), otherwise to the ordinary fight 95. Crisis variants add the five-minute jokes.

scenes.title: Endings
scenes.notes: 42F is routed by endingResult(): good requires seven earned Balls, Frieza defeated, the fed Beast beaten and an intact Fortress.

scenes.title: Shenron's wish and King Kai's planet
scenes.notes: Shenron repairs the core, fallout and craters; Randi lives in Potos; Popoi returns only to a party that recruited him. Cue events A3–A6/DE/E4 drive the JS ending surface (dragon, wish, village, depart, Kai).
scenes.dialogue: buildFriezaEnding + heroFarewell; King Kai's qualified congratulations.

scenes.title: Doomed world and King Kai's scolding
scenes.notes: Four reasons (fortress, balls, frieza, beast) each with a cause line; the planet explodes and Goku teleports to Kai.

scenes.title: Retail credits montage (bypassed)
scenes.notes: The retail ending forcibly recruits Primm and assumes Popoi has vanished; the mod's 42F replaces it, so 4FD/3FF remain reachable only from the cartridge's own table.

launch.note: Bypassed by the mod; only reachable by requesting 4FD with the mod disabled.

scenes.title: Cannon Travel
scenes.notes: Cannon brothers' destination menus. The cannon return (F7) is recompiled so Goku brakes upright.

scenes.title: Weapon and seed rewards
scenes.notes: Shared reward subroutines (Got <weapon>, seed power, orb responses). Senzu renaming is applied by the story compiler.

launch.note: Shared subroutines; launch the scene that calls one (see backlinks).

scenes.title: Inns, shops and Neko
scenes.notes: Native service menus. During the crisis they get one warning greeting before normal service.

launch.note: Talk to any inn, shop or Neko NPC; crisis greetings need ?start=fortress.

scenes.title: Ki-breakable barriers and doors
scenes.notes: Beams that touch a gated barrier run its authored reaction. Breakable doors swap in opened event variants. Destroying the Earth Palace stair burner restores its original door triggers.
scenes.dialogue: barrierReactions in native-radio.js.

launch.note: Fire a beam at a barrier listed in kiBarriers; launch witch-castle or northtown.

scenes.title: King Kai's radio
scenes.notes: PPU message surface, not an event: never takes input or opens $D0, so it cannot cancel a held Kamehameha.
scenes.dialogue: kaiWarnings, firstFlightMessages, treeBlastMessages, dungeonQuips.

launch.note: Radio lines fire from flight, barriers and dungeon entries; try ?start=flight.

scenes.title: First transformation and flight tutorials
scenes.dialogue: powerIntroMessages.

launch.note: Shown on the first transformation and first flight after ?start=sword.

scenes.title: Scouter and Analyzer power levels
scenes.notes: Sylphid's grant (583) also gives Goku a scouter: owned once $CFAB >= 2. L+X (Shift+A) scans everyone on screen; Primm's Analyzer (spell 17h) shows its target's reading whenever the cartridge writes 17h into the target's +181h. Goku reads 90,000 (150,000,000 in Super Saiyan), Frieza 60M / 120M at full power, everyone else from max HP.
scenes.dialogue: Sylphid hands over the glass in 583 (retailDialogue); King Kai's first-scan jokes live in scouter.js.

launch.note: Reach the Wind Palace (wind-palace scene), or set $CFAB to 2, then press L+X near enemies.

scenes.title: Party defeat and revival
scenes.notes: 7FF is the native defeat dispatcher: it branches on flag B to the revival scene (7FE) or the coached retry (7FD). Both are original text in which Goku is woken and coached.

launch.note: Reached when the whole party falls; Frieza and the Mana Beast use battle-retry instead.

scenes.title: Button-icon hint windows
scenes.notes: Short prompts drawn with control glyphs (D0–D2) rather than letters, shown on the Potos south field.

launch.note: Shown when walking the Potos south field after the sword scene.

scenes.title: Entry prerequisites for sequence breaks
scenes.notes: Floors seeded on entry so flying in never strands progress; never lowers flags or completes bosses.

launch.note: Applied when entering map 240 or 377; launch fire-palace or empire-castle.

scenes.title: Late-game test staging room
scenes.notes: bootLateGame temporarily rewrites events 400/106 into a door to the Dryad seed room and restores them before any checkpoint.
